about: The default network: `pyrtan join` with no invite (or `pyrtan hub --join default`) puts a hub in it and follows the first hub in hubs.json that answers, then the snapshot's hubs. Its secret is public on purpose: it names the network rather than guarding it, so anyone may join, and following stays one-directional trust. A network of your own is `pyrtan network new NAME`; its invite is yours to share.
name: pyrtan
